title: Xdrip+ in Android Wear watch?
body:
I would like to be able to use a Libre-Blucon
-Smartwatch combination as a CGM with alarms. I would like to wear my Sony SmartWatch 3 without using a phone - except during the installation.
I’ve tried Xdrip since I understand that it can collect the bluetooth signals without a phone, but I don’t get any graphs, the Xdrip Wear App is only seen as alerts.
After LCA43 I’ve restored the firmware to M1D64T, but I still don’t get any Xdrip app or watch face in the watch, except the alerts who appear on the screen regardless of what watch face I use. Could it be caused by the fact that you download Xdrip as an .apk from Github and hence it’s not visible in the ”My apps” in Play Store and maybe doesn’t get synced to the watch with Android Wear...? Am I missing something?

comments.body: Please let me add my question here as well: Is it possible at all to have a direct bluetooth connection between Libre-Blucon to any wearable smartwatch? I would like to gift this to my wife, but it seems very confusing since I do not have a smartwatch yet and I am unfamiliar with app installs. Do you need Android Wear or would Tizen also be an option?
I updated to Oct25th version of Xdrip and instantly got the watch face. This way I have a Libre-Blucon CGM in my Sony Smartwatch 3 (SWR50). It’s eating battery though!
Is the SSW3 the best watch to run libre-Blucon Nightrider?

@peterhallforone Would you please close this issue if your questions have been answered?
Otherwise, you can use the support channels.
